question: Padma Bhushan awardee Vikku Vinayakaram is a __________ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghatam**__

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The ghatam is an** ancient percussion instrument** in used Carnatic classical music
 
• The ghatam consists of a clay pot reinforced with brass, copper and iron fillings. 
 
• The pitch of the ghatam is unique and can only be slightly modified by water and additional clay.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The pakhavaj is a barrel-shaped, two-headed drum, originating from the Indian subcontinent​ **

 
 
• it is the oldest version of double sided drums and its descendants are mridangam of Southern India and kendang of Maritime Southeast Asia and other South Asian double-headed drums.
 
 
 
• **Dholak is about 45 cm in length and 27 **cm in breadth and is widely used in** qawwali, kirtan, lavani and bhangra.**
 
 
• The drum has two different sized drumheads. 
 
 
 
• **Tabla word is derived from the Arabic word “tabl” **which means a “drum”. Tabla is the most commonly used membranophone percussion musical instrument in Hindustani classical music.
